title: AI Architect
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Serve as the principal architect for AI-enabled solutions supporting Finance, designing and delivering secure, scalable, and maintainable systems on AWS. Translate finance business needs into solution architectures that improve the quality, speed, and efficiency of financial planning, reporting, forecasting, and operations. Apply expertise in generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, data architecture, cloud platforms, and software engineering to address significant business problems. Evaluate emerging technologies and integrate them where they provide measurable value, while ensuring solutions align with enterprise architecture, financial controls, data governance, security, and responsible-AI expectations. Act as a technical leader across Finance and IT, guiding architecture decisions and delivery teams from discovery through production and ongoing improvement.​
Responsibilities:
​​Lead architecture and solution design. Translate Finance requirements into end-to-end architectures for generative and agentic AI, machine learning, analytics, data, and software solutions on AWS, including integrations with enterprise platforms and existing finance systems.
​Identify and deliver high-value use cases. Partner with Finance stakeholders to assess opportunities such as forecasting, planning, reporting, reconciliation, close-process support, and document or transaction analysis; define solution scope, success measures, and implementation approaches.
​Design and implement secure AWS solutions. Select and apply appropriate AWS services and architectural patterns for data ingestion, storage, processing, analytics, AI/ML, application development, and deployment. Address scalability, resilience, performance, cost, and operational support.
​Establish data and AI governance. Ensure solutions use trusted, well-managed financial data, with appropriate lineage, quality controls, access management, retention, and auditability. Incorporate human review and escalation where warranted by the use case.
​Apply responsible-AI and model-lifecycle practices. Guide model and generative-AI evaluation, validation, monitoring, explainability, versioning, and change management in accordance with applicable enterprise standards and risk controls. Identify limitations and risks, including inaccurate outputs, bias, privacy exposure, and model drift.
​Protect financial information and controls. Incorporate security, privacy, segregation of duties, and applicable financial reporting and internal-control requirements into solution designs. Work with Finance, Security, Risk, Compliance, and other control partners to address requirements and support audits.
​Guide implementation and technical decisions. Evaluate build, reuse, and purchase options; recommend solutions based on business value, technical fit, risk, and total cost of ownership. Contribute to prototypes or code where needed to validate architecture and resolve key technical challenges.
​Advise stakeholders and delivery teams. Provide technical consultation to Finance and IT leaders, product owners, engineers, data teams, and operations partners. Communicate architectural choices, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
​Promote reliable operations and continuous improvement. Define production-readiness expectations, including testing, deployment, monitoring, incident response, documentation, and ongoing cost and performance optimization. Incorporate user feedback and operational lessons into solution improvements.
​Provide technical leadership and uphold standards. Work autonomously with minimal direction, mentor architects and delivery team members as appropriate, and promote adherence to enterprise architecture, software-development, cloud, data, security, conduct, and other applicable corporate policies.
Bachelor’s Degree with 7 years of relevant experience; Master’s Degree with 6 years of experience; or PhD with 2 years of experience.
Respective years of experience in application development, solution architecture for AI applications.
​In-depth knowledge of the systems development life cycle, solution architecture, and the design and delivery of production-grade cloud, data, and analytics solutions for generative and agentic AI and ML applications.
​Demonstrated experience designing or implementing solutions on AWS, including appropriate services and patterns for data management, security, integration, deployment, monitoring, and cost optimization.
​Strong understanding of generative and agentic AI capabilities, limitations, and lifecycle practices, including evaluation, validation, monitoring, and responsible use.
​Knowledge of data governance, privacy, access control, auditability, and financial controls, with the ability to incorporate applicable requirements into solution designs.
​Proven track record of delivering creative technology solutions that advance business outcomes, with experience evaluating alternatives and balancing value, risk, feasibility, and total cost of ownership.
​Excellent written and oral English communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts, risks, and trade-offs to technical and nontechnical audiences.

As part of AbbVie’s Business Technology Solutions (BTS) team, R&D Global Therapeutics is dedicated to building and deploying scalable, business-driven Artificial Intelligence (AI) Applications. We are seeking an innovative and highly skilled AI Senior Business Systems Consultant, to lead the strategy and execution of automation initiatives, with an emphasis on AI safety solutions.

Proactively seeks out strategic business opportunities with high-level business unit executives. Provide advice, assistance and leadership in any area associated with the planning, procurement, provision, delivery, management, maintenance, and effective business use of information systems for a business area. Analyze business processes; elicit, analyze, and document business requirements; identify alternative solutions, assess feasibility, and make recommendations typically seeking to exploit and leverage new or existing technology components. Translate business requirements into functional requirements; perform data and process modeling; manage change; and lead, coordinate/perform testing, verification, and validation of requirements.​
Responsibilities:
Work with senior business unit clients to understand specific business processes, business drivers, and business strategy across multiple functions; Personally, or through indirect team management identify, prioritize and communicate resulting needs and opportunities for business process improvement that can be enabled via technology; Use consulting skills and expertise to translate business requirements to BTS and functional requirements to the domain.
Investigate and understand capabilities of existing systems and technologies already in use across the business area and similar and interconnected business areas in AbbVie and investigate available technologies applied to this business area in industry; identify information required to support the business strategy and lead the development of appropriate information management strategies and developing them as an integrated part of the business strategy.
Define needed human and technology capabilities contributing to and helping to build necessary training. Mentor, Identify, communicate, and actively participate in opportunities to improve process and/or technology. These may include business process outsourcing, application development, or adopting business process management (BPM) practices.
Accountable for the creation and further refinement of project requirements and for BTO Demand initiation and coordination.  Anticipate project/program risks, define mitigation plans, and work with teams to implement. Working with business partners and BTO management, responsible for resolving changes to scope, issues, and risks that will affect multiple and/or large-scale projects/programs.
Simultaneously consider objectives of multiple functions. Measure performance to ensure the project is progressing as compared to original plan and budget. Accountable for the accuracy of the fit of the proposed business process improvements and the technical solution to the business need and the information upon which the business justification and prioritization decisions are made. Understand and execute AbbVie's vision, goals and strategies and use this understanding to broker services.
As an individual contributor adeptly navigate cross-functional and highly matrixed teams through indirect authority. Has defined authority and responsibility for a significant area of work, including technical, financial, and quality aspects, and delegate assignments across multiple and/or large-scale projects/programs. Accountable for actions and decisions taken by self and project teams.
Anticipate and respond to current and emerging business needs and evaluate alternative IT solutions using standard information systems methodologies and best practices. Determine necessary resources to ensure program and business needs are addressed through proactive priority management with business leaders. Manage, motivate, and mentor cross-functional and enterprise project teams. Work with governance bodies to ensure alignment.
Build collaborative relationships and effectively interact frequently with business and/or technology senior leaders. Act as a liaison and business process expert to IT organizations to ensure successful implementation. Serve as a source of information to the service organizations on the business drivers, processes, and organization structure and dynamics of multiple business areas. Subject matter expert in their technology and/or functional domain.
Interact well with diverse groups within function and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external collaborators. Consistently demonstrate AbbVie's Ways of Working and Leadership Attributes including an enterprise mindset and people leadership. Serve as a mentor to develop and recognize talent. Ability to communicate problems in terms that are understandable to BTS Leadership and end users at all levels.
Required:
Bachelor's Degree with 8 years of experience; Master's Degree with 7 years of experience; PhD with 3 years of experience.
3+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, or similar role in a technical environment or product management.
Strong leadership and team management abilities, with experience leading cross-functional teams.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Proven track record of managing the development and launch of successful software products.
Knowledge of software development best practices.
Proficiency in Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence).
Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.
Preferred:
​ Understanding of Large Language Models, Generative AI, traditional AI and how to apply them and select for best fit.
​Experience working in the Life Sciences industry.
​Experience with GxP validated systems​.
Technical Writing Skills

Purpose
Reporting to the Director, Strategy, Analytics & Business Insights (SABI), the Associate Director, Business Insights serves as the primary analytical and strategic partner to the Clinical Site Management (CSM) organization. This role owns portfolio-level business insights for Clinical Site Management — translating complex, ambiguous business questions into data-driven analyses that directly inform Sr. Director and VP-level decisions across site strategy, study design, resourcing, and risk management. The Associate Director builds and sustains trusted relationships with Sr. Directors and their leadership teams across all geographic areas and across the clinical study lifecycle, ensuring SABI’s analytical capabilities are embedded into how every leader plans and executes their operation strategies.
Responsibilities
Strategic Partnership & Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as the primary SABI point of contact and trusted advisor to Area heads and Clinical Field Excellence leadership, proactively identifying where data and analytics can resolve ambiguity in portfolio-level decisions.
End-to-End Insight Delivery: Lead delivery of portfolio-level insights — from hypothesis generation and data identification through analysis, insight generation, and recommendations — following SABI’s hypothesis-driven problem-solving approach.
Analytical Product Ownership: Own and evolve key analytical products for Clinical Site Management (e.g., site ID and allocation models, country/site performance benchmarking, enrollment scenario planning, operational trend analyses), ensuring they remain decision-relevant as portfolio priorities shift.
Cross-Geographic Support — Americas to Europe to Intercontinental: Provide analytical and decision-support coverage to all global stakeholders, extending proven approaches where transferable and adapting them to country/region-specific needs.
Business Need Translation: Partner with Sr. Directors and CSM leadership across all functions to translate emerging business needs into scoped, actionable analytical workstreams.
Executive Communication: Influence Sr. Directors/VP-level decisions, tailoring communication to executive audiences.
Risk & Gap Identification: Identify and escalate structural gaps or unaddressed risks within the CSM functions that are not yet visible to leadership, bringing an independent analytical lens to surface them.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with SABI’s other leads (across CSL and CSM) and adjacent CAP functions (Study Feasibility & Analytics, Clinical Acceleration Solutions) to ensure consistency and reuse of analytical approaches across therapeutic areas.
CDO-Wide Initiatives: Provide analytical and strategic support for priority CDO-wide initiatives, partnering across functions and applying SABI capabilities beyond assigned therapeutic areas to advance enterprise objectives.
Team Capability Development: Provide project-based coaching and mentorship to junior team members and rotational analysts supporting SABI work, while maintaining accountability for the quality and analytical rigor of assigned outputs.
Global Stewardship: Maintain a global mindset with an objective and long-term view of stakeholder needs across all CSM functions, balancing responsiveness to Sr. Director requests with SABI’s focus on high-impact, analytically complex work.
Required:
Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree in Finance, Analytics, Business, or related quantitative field preferred
10+ years of relevant experience in business analytics, strategy, or a related client-facing analytical role, ideally within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare. 5+ years of relevant experience for advanced degree holders (e.g. PhD, MD, PharmD)
Demonstrated experience managing senior stakeholder relationships (Director/Sr. Director level or above), including delivering findings and recommendations to executive audiences
Strong analytical and strategic decision-support skills, with the ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured, data-driven analyses
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to distill complex analyses into clear, actionable insights for non-technical audiences
Experience with data analytics/visualization tools (e.g., SQL, Power BI, Excel)
Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams independently, across more than one therapeutic area or stakeholder group, with sound judgment on prioritization and escalation
Familiarity with clinical trial operations, drug development, or R&D processes
Experience supporting multiple therapeutic areas or portfolios concurrently

Prior people-management or mentoring experience
Working knowledge of AbbVie systems and organizational structure

The Associate Director, Field Tools & Analytics owns the overall strategy, technology roadmap, and solution architecture for Oncology field tools that enable the sales organization to operate effectively across solid and liquid tumor brands. This role sets the long-range vision for field tools, determines platform and technology investments, and ensures tools scale with evolving brand and franchise needs. The Associate Director leads a team of two direct reports (Senior Manager and Manager, Field Tools & Analytics) who execute day-to-day operations against this strategy.
Responsibilities
Strategic Planning & Technology Roadmap
Own and author the long-range strategic plan and multi-year technology roadmap for all Oncology field tools.
Set priorities for platform investment, retirement, and consolidation decisions based on franchise needs and ROI.
Anticipate future field force needs and proactively evolve the toolset ahead of business demand.
Solution Architecture & System Design
Architect end-to-end field tool solutions, defining system design, data flows, and integration points across CRM, analytics, and reporting platforms.
Set technical and business requirement standards; final approver on major system design decisions.
Partner with IT, BTS, and OEC to ensure architecture aligns with enterprise technology standards and compliance requirements.
Governance & Cross-Functional Leadership
Serve as the executive-level point of contact and escalation path across Sales Leadership, Commercial Operations, IT, Training, OEC, Legal, and Medical/Regulatory.
Provide final sign-off on business requirements, enhancement prioritization, and project scope for major initiatives.
Lead cross-functional governance forums to align technology decisions with brand and franchise strategy.
Team Leadership & People Management
Directly manage and develop the Senior Manager and Manager, Field Tools & Analytics.
Ensure the team is resourced appropriately for current and future demand; delegate operational execution to direct reports.
Coach, mentor, and set clear goals/expectations; conduct performance management and career development.
Executive Stakeholder Relationship Management
Build and maintain trusted relationships with VPs, Sales Directors, and Analytics leadership.
Act as a credible, strategic advisor capable of influencing senior executives on technology direction and investment decisions without direct authority.
BA/BS degree required; advanced degree preferred.
8+ years of pharmaceutical or relevant industry experience, including experience setting technology strategy or architecting commercial solutions.
Demonstrated people leadership experience managing managers or senior individual contributors.
Strong executive presence; able to confidently advise Executive and Sales Leadership on strategic technology decisions.
Preferred Technical Skills
Salesforce/Veeva CRM: strategic and architectural understanding of platform capability.
Data analytics platforms (Tableau, Power BI, QlikView) — ability to evaluate and select tools at an enterprise level.
SQL or equivalent database management — able to assess data architecture decisions.
Working knowledge of Python/R for evaluating analytical approaches (hands-on execution not required).
Core Competencies
Strategic and long-range planning
Enterprise solution architecture
Executive influence and communication
People leadership and talent development
Business acumen / financial analysis

title: Associate Director, Global Business Development Forecasting
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Business Development is a critical pillar of AbbVie’s future growth, and Global Business Development Forecasting helps determine which external opportunities can create the greatest long-term value. The team brings commercial insight, analytical rigor, and strategic clarity to high-stakes BD decisions by translating science, market dynamics, competitive context, and uncertainty into actionable forecasts.
The Associate Director plays a high-impact and highly visible role in this process, leading forecasts and commercial perspectives that shape executive understanding of opportunity value, risk, and strategic fit. Working across R&D, Commercial, Pipeline Commercial Strategy, CBSO, BD Finance, and other partners, this role sits at the intersection of scientific innovation and commercial strategy and directly supports decisions that influence AbbVie’s future portfolio.
Success requires strong forecasting and commercial analytics expertise, rigorous assumption development, clear executive communication, and the ability to influence across a matrixed organization. Candidates should be curious, collaborative, comfortable with ambiguity, and able to create structure in fast-moving situations. For the right candidate, the role offers meaningful growth through exposure to senior leaders, enterprise-wide relationships, and deeper understanding of both R&D and Commercial strategy.
This role reports to the Director, Global Business Development Forecasting.
Responsibilities
Lead commercial forecasting, market assessments, scenario analyses, and commercial P&Ls for BD opportunities, balancing analytical rigor with timely decision support in a fast-paced environment.
Develop patient-based forecast models, pressure-test assumptions, and apply primary research, secondary data, epidemiology, competitive intelligence, market access input, and expert perspectives to build a well-supported commercial view.
Partner broadly across BD, PCS, finance, market access, epidemiology, marketing analytics, and senior leadership to align assumptions, clarify risks and opportunities, and ensure commercial perspectives are reflected in deal valuation and governance discussions.
Translate complex analyses into clear recommendations, executive-ready narratives, and decision options for senior leaders and governance forums, facilitating productive discussion around uncertainty, trade-offs, and strategic implications.
Advance BD forecasting capabilities by sharing best practices, improving tools and processes, and helping create faster, more consistent, and audit-ready ways of working.
Education and experience:  7+ years of relevant forecasting, market analytics, finance, or life sciences consulting experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, or related industries; MBA or other advanced degree preferred. Bachelor’s degree in finance/accounting or business required.
Forecasting and analytics skills:  Experience building forecast models in Excel and forecasting platforms such as IQVIA Forecast Horizon; ability to develop and/or utilize patient-flow modeling approaches, craft robust assumptions, and prepare evidence-based forecast inputs from epidemiology, secondary data, market research, treatment dynamics, competitive profiles, and expert input.  Familiar with key data sources used to substantiate forecast recommendations and demonstrated ability to clearly document forecast assumption logic and rationale.  Familiarity with using and crafting Target Product Profiles (TPPs), establishing and aligning analytical business rules and market definitions, and leveraging claims data analytics is also highly desirable.
Business and therapeutic area knowledge:  Experience supporting strategic decision making in specialized therapeutic areas such as Neuroscience, Immunology, Oncology, or other complex markets is preferred; ability to apply data, assumptions, and market context effectively is critical.
Communication and influence:  Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to tailor messages by audience, translate complex quantitative analyses into recommendations and decision options, and influence stakeholders across functions and cultures without direct authority.
Project leadership:  Strong project management skills in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, with the ability to prioritize multiple workstreams, communicate trade-offs, escalate risks appropriately, and deliver high-quality work under time pressure.

description:

Purpose
The Associate Director, Medical Affairs + Health Impact (MHI) Therapeutic Area Communications, develops and executes an integrated communications strategy spanning Medical Affairs and Value & Evidence within a designated therapeutic area. The Associate Director amplifies MHI’s contributions and supporting evidence to strengthen pipeline and brand narratives, demonstrating how scientific innovation addresses unmet need, closes care gaps, elevates the standard of care and delivers value across the healthcare system.
The role partners with Pipeline & External Innovation Communications, Commercial Communications, Global Patient & Community Partnerships and other cross-functional stakeholders to coordinate plans and deliver on shared priorities. The role reports to the Director of MHI Communications within the Corporate Affairs organization.
Responsibilities
Serve as communications partner with the MHI therapeutic area vice president and leadership team.
Develop communications strategies that amplify MHI-generated evidence, medical education and capabilities to strengthen pipeline and brand narratives and demonstrate how scientific innovation addresses unmet needs, closes care gaps, elevates the standard of care and delivers value across the healthcare system.

Demonstrate understanding of the external environment, stakeholder insights and performance data; track objectives and KPIs; report results; and recommend improvements to plans and execution.
Support cross-R&D initiatives that elevate MHI’s contributions, as well as KOL engagement opportunities to advance MHI leadership visibility and communications objectives.
Manage workstreams, agency partners, budgets, timelines and review processes, contributing to annual planning, prioritization and continuous improvement across the R&D Communications operating model.

Minimum of 5+ years of experience in integrated communications, preferably in the healthcare, biotechnology or pharmaceutical industries.
Solid understanding of the drug development lifecycle and the broader life sciences industry.

Partners with the investigator and site staff for meaningful and effective engagements positioning AbbVie as the choice in clinical trials.
Focus on site clinical research that ensures appropriate conduct of the trial while driving improvement in data integrity, compliance, overall study performance and customer experience.

Considered as the primary point of contact for the investigative site. High level of competency or experience in providing contextual information on the clinical trials, connects stakeholder to the investigative sites and strengthens AbbVie’s positioning.

Advanced understanding of site engagement and ability to customize site engagement strategy for assigned study (ies). Gather local/site insights and utilize site engagement tools such as the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tool, to report/track progress and measure impact of that strategy.

Possesses experienced level of competency to mentor and train less experienced CRAs on various aspects of work and provides input into their development.
May participate in global/local task forces and initiatives. Responsible for activities as assigned by manager.
Responsible for continuous risk-assessment proactively, and in collaboration with Central Monitoring team, monitor activities conducted by clinical sites to detect early overall study performance or patient safety issues.
Advanced ability to think critically to resolve site risk signals while having robust understanding of site processes to drive study execution. Ensures preventative and corrective action plans are put into place, as needed, to mitigate risk and promote compliance using a customer centric approach.
Identifies, evaluates and recommends new/potential investigators/sites on an on going basis. Potential sites may be identified through networking or internal AbbVie requests to assist in the placement of planned clinical studies with qualified investigators.
Ensures quality of data submitted from study sites and assures timely submission of data, including appropriate reporting and follow-up for all safety events by site personnel.
Ensures audit and regulatory inspection readiness at assigned clinical site at all times.
Manages investigator payments as per executed contract obligations, as applicable.
Appropriate tertiary qualification in health related disciplines (Medical, Scientific, Nursing) preferred.
Minimum of 1 year of clinically related experience, of which a period of 6 months is required in clinical research monitoring of investigational drug or device trials. Familiar with risk‐based monitoring approach, onsite and offsite monitoring.
Knowledge of appropriate therapeutic area indications is preferred with the ability to understand and apply scientific concepts as they relate to the conduct of clinical trials.
Advanced knowledge on existing and emerging local regulatory and legal requirements, ICH/GCP Guidelines and applicable policies.
Demonstrate strong cross-functional collaboration skills among internal and external stakeholders.
Demonstrate strong planning and organizational skills and the ability to work effectively and efficiently in a dynamic environment with competing projects and deadlines.
Advanced ability to leverage technology, tools and resources to provide customer centric support based on the health of the site.
Strong interpersonal skills with excellent written, verbal, active listening and presentation skills, with ability to establish and leverage site relationships and trusted partnerships through engagement, motivation, and training.
Ability to use functional expertise with appropriate guidance, leverage critical thinking skills and apply good judgement to address clinical site issues.

Manufacturing equipment and processes require a high degree of specialized attention around the clock. title: Postdoctoral Fellow, Materials Science & Characterization PPG Analytical
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube .
Purpose:
AbbVie is seeking a highly motivated, scientifically rigorous and collaborative postdoctoral fellow to join the Materials Science & Characterization Team in PDST / PPG Analytical to advance AI-enabled, multimodal characterization of targeted lipid nanoparticles (tLNPs). This position offers an opportunity to lead the generation, integration, and curation of an analytical dataset using experimental characterization data generated internally and data received predominantly from external laboratories and contract research organizations (CROs). During the first half of the appointment, the primary focus will be on analytical data generation, data quality assessment, standardization, and curation; during the second half, the fellow will increasingly apply feature extraction and interpretable statistical and machine-learning analyses to identify attributes associated with particle heterogeneity, stability, product quality, and functional performance in support of tLNP development.  The successful candidate will design and execute experiments, analyze and interpret data, collaborate with multidisciplinary partners, and contribute to scientific publications, presentations, and internal knowledge sharing. The goal of this position is to generate new insights, methods, or capabilities that advance Product Development Science & Technology priorities and support innovation of future commercial delivery approaches for Oncology and Immunology Therapies.
Responsibilities
Own and execute fit-for-purpose tLNP analytical-data programs, incorporating internally generated data and analytical data received predominantly from external laboratories and CROs, in alignment with project objectives.
Design rigorous experiments and analytical workflows ; define data-transfer, quality-assessment, and documentation requirements for internally and externally generated datasets; and establish consistent reporting standards to support high-quality tLNP development and decision-making.
Define and manage batch metadata, sampling strategies, sample-tracking requirements, and provenance for samples and data generated internally or received from external partners
Build, integrate curate, and maintain validated multimodal characterization datasets across analytical platforms, with an initial emphasis on data generation, quality assessment, harmonization, and curation.
Analyze and harmonize quantitative features related to particle size, morphology, aggregation, thermal behavior, spectroscopy, encapsulation, and accessibility.
Following establishment of a sufficiently curated analytical dataset, develop and apply interpretable statistical, computational, and machine-learning approaches to identify quality-relevant attributes, fingerprint batches, assess heterogeneity and stability risks, and evaluate structure–function relationships.
Troubleshoot technical challenges; assess the quality, completeness, and interpretability of internally and externally generated analytical data; recommend alternative approaches; and design targeted follow-up experiments or analyses.
Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams by communicating scientific plans, progress, results, and recommendations;
Contribute to publications, abstracts, presentations, patent filings, and other scientific communications;
Maintain awareness of relevant scientific literature, emerging technologies, and external developments in the field.
Ensure work is conducted in alignment with applicable safety, quality, compliance, and documentation expectations.
PhD in materials science, chemical engineering, biophysics, physical chemistry, analytical chemistry or related discipline.
Experience with tLNP formulation, manufacturing, characterization, and stress, stability, and comparative studies or a combination thereof.
Expertise in advanced analytical instrumentation and nanoparticle characterization, including Cryo-EM, SAXS, DLS, NTA, DSC, fluorescence, and or optical techniques.
Strong combination of hands-on experimental expertise, analytical data generation and curation experience, quantitative data analysis, multivariate statistics, and an interest in developing interpretable machine-learning approaches.
Ability to integrate complex formulation, process, stability, biophysical, bioanalytical, and functional datasets from internal and external sources; apply sound scientific judgment; and communicate insights clearly.

title: Principal Data Scientist
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
The Principal Data Scientist is the senior technical and scientific leader for AbbVie's omnichannel engagement analytics, a data and analytics-driven engagement optimization program spanning channel mix, content, field representative call planning, and orchestration. Operating within the APEX Enterprise Advanced Analytics and Innovation team, this role sets the multi-year science vision for personalized commercial engagement and is accountable for the technical strategy, methodology, and scientific rigor of the AI/ML and statistical solutions that power it. Reporting to the Associate Director, Data Science, the Principal is a thought partner to commercial and analytics leadership: shaping which problems are worth solving, forming and defending a point of view on how AI creates measurable business value, and partnering with product owners to turn that vision into scalable solutions. The role combines deep, hands-on expertise in applied machine learning, generative AI, causal inference, and experimentation with the consultative skill to align a complex stakeholder ecosystem around the right answer.
Key Responsibilities
Define the Data Science vision: Own the multi-year Data Science vision and technical roadmap for omnichannel engagement analytics, anticipating where both the business and the field of AI are heading.
Shape how AI creates business value: identify, size, and prioritize opportunities where AI can drive measurable commercial impact, build the business case, and influence senior leadership decisions on where to invest.
Lead hands-on with Gen-AI: Personally use AI-assisted development and agentic tools to prototype, test hypotheses, and demonstrate value quickly; build LLM-backed systems using advanced RAG and context engineering, paired with rigorous scientific evaluation frameworks to scale highly reliable omnichannel recommendations.
Lead the design of predictive and causal models: Develop next-best-action, recommendation, and sequential decision models that inform customer engagement and resource allocation using complex, multi-source data.
Own measurement science: set the standard for measuring effectiveness, incrementality, and business impact using experimental and quasi-experimental methods, so that AI investments are evaluated rigorously.
Partner with product owners to shape problems, not just fulfill requirements: co-define business outcomes, scope, and success metrics, and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
Navigate a complex stakeholder ecosystem: build alignment across brand and marketing leaders, field sales and operations, Medical, Legal and Regulatory (MLR), Compliance, BTS, Digital Lab, and external vendors; reframe requests into well-posed problems and resolve competing priorities.
Communicate with executive impact: translate complex methods and findings into clear recommendations and compelling narratives for executive and non-technical audiences.
Productionize at scale: Partner with BTS, Digital Lab, engineering, and platform teams to deploy, monitor, and manage the lifecycle of AI/ML solutions.
Raise the bar for scientific rigor: establish best practices in model development, code quality, reproducibility, peer review, and responsible AI across the data science community.
Be a thought leader: stay at the forefront of research and practice in machine learning, generative AI, and causal inference; bring new ideas into the team; provoke rigorous analytical debate; and represent AbbVie's point of view internally and in the broader analytics community.
Supervisory / Management Responsibilities
This role does not carry formal direct report responsibilities but is expected to act as a technical leader and mentor across the broader data science community, raising the bar on scientific rigor and hands-on AI practice. The Principal Data Scientist may lead technical workstreams with external analytics vendors and partners, including oversight of deliverable quality and methodology validation.
Key Competencies
Scientific Engineering Depth: Deep expertise in machine learning, causal inference, and generative AI, combined with strong engineering discipline in reproducibility, deployment, and enterprise integration.
AI Fluency and Bias to Action: Uses AI hands-on in daily work to prototype, analyze, and build; critically evaluates AI output; and turns ideas into working solutions quickly.
Business Judgment and Problem-Framing: Translates ambiguous business challenges into well-scoped problems, connects technical choices to commercial value, and sets long-term technical direction while staying close to delivery.
Stakeholder Navigation and Executive Influence: Reads organizational dynamics to build alignment across commercial, regulatory, and technology partners, earning trust as a thought partner to win support from senior leaders.
Thought Leadership: Challenges conventional thinking and sparks meaningful analytical debate with peers and executives.
Education
Bachelor’s Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline required; Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field strongly preferred.
Required Experience
8+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or applied science (or 6+ years with a PhD), with a track record of delivering production-quality models that drove measurable business impact.
Demonstrated experience setting technical direction for a portfolio of AI/ML solutions and influencing decisions of senior business leaders.
Experience building personalization, recommendation, decision-optimization, or marketing-science solutions, in any industry.
Deep hands-on expertise in causal inference and experimentation, including A/B testing and quasi-experimental methods, to measure business impact.
Demonstrated hands-on experience using generative AI and AI-assisted development tools (e.g., LLM APIs, AI coding assistants, agent frameworks) to prototype and deliver solutions, with concrete examples that can be walked through during the interview process.
Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience in deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and distributed data processing.
Experience productionizing AI/ML solutions in cloud environments, including deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Track record of leading initiatives across complex, cross-functional stakeholder environments and presenting to executive audiences.
Preferred Experience
Commercial analytics experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare, or life sciences, including familiarity with data sources such as IQVIA, Symphony Health, APLD, or similar Rx, claims, and engagement data.
Experience in omnichannel analytics, such as journey analysis, touchpoint measurement, closed-loop measurement, or next-best-action for HCP or patient engagement.
Experience with advanced ML and optimization methods, including reinforcement learning, multi-armed bandits, transformers, and other approaches for sequential or recommendation use cases.
Experience building LLM-based and agentic AI systems, including orchestration frameworks, evaluation, and integration through APIs and pipelines.
Experience with cloud ML platforms and MLOps tools such as Azure ML, Databricks, and MLflow.
External visibility through conference talks, publications, patents, open-source contributions, or recognized industry thought leadership.
Experience working in agile product development environments.

Effective and timely communication of development plans, risks, and mitigation plans to stakeholders and line management.

We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
This role is field-based. Preference is to live within the region, or within close proximity with access to a major airport nearby in order to access HQ cities.
The region includes the following states:
Texas
Oklahoma
Kansas
Arkansas
Missouri
Tennessee
Louisiana
Mississippi
Alabama
Kentucky
This position leads, manages and coaches a regional team of Immunology Account Executives. Primary objectives include assessing regional business opportunity within assigned regional geography and priority Immunology Accounts (includes IDN Health Systems, Group Practices, hospital systems and specialty pharmacies) in order to deliver on assigned product performance goals.  It requires understanding of Immunology brand value propositions and implication for effective execution of these within target accounts, and with key customer influencers and decision-makers, by direct reports who engage key customers.  The position overlays multiple Immunology field sales organizations and AbbVie in-field support teams, requiring extensive communication and collaborative actions at the Region-level.
Responsibilities:
People Leadership
Develop, implement and execute effective skill development plans for direct reports. Deliver consistent coaching direction via field-travel and engagement with IAEs during business and key account planning discussions.  Evaluate execution of franchise strategic and tactical priorities of direct reports and generate effective plans to insure performance of IAE’s to behavioral expectations in support of organizational objectives.
Lead KAM and internal business partnership communication and collaboration to insure highly effective, coordinated execution of AbbVie Immunology and IAE core priorities.  Monitor and enhance IFT partner clarity on IAE roles and priorities across key partner organizations.
Develop, monitor and advance development planning process with direct reports.  Actively lead engagement of direct reports and IFT partners to elevate IAE organizational Inclusion and Culture goals.
Business Strategy (Analysis, Planning, Execution)
Clarify and integrate marketing strategies into regional execution, including sales training needs, during in-field and National/Regional meetings, with the purpose of elevating regional effectiveness within key account management.
Work with peers in Market Access and Trade to understand the changing Healthcare Landscape and proactively identify potential health system opportunities and conceptualize solutions using creativity and innovation within approved standards and resources.
Understand, execute and coach to appropriate use of approved promotional materials with health economic messaging.
Lead analysis and application of sales data in coordination direct reports, including coordination with partner sales management and sales operations, to inform business understanding and strategic planning and execution in order to achieve sales objectives.
Utilize IAE analytic tools, including CURO, to assess Regional and territory sales performance trends and create strategic selling initiatives to address performance opportunities.  Gather, organize and communicate monthly Regional performance vs. key business objectives.  Includes Q&I reports, CURO, Key Account Performance and resource execution.
Work with franchise leadership team to develop, implement and execute regional pull-through execution plans in support of IAE and Immunology core execution priorities (Business Planning, Selling Skills, Coaching).
Drive regional execution of business planning and Key Account planning process; manage direct reports to the same process.  This includes leading the effective assimilation of evolving account targeting and approved messaging strategies into regional execution.  Monitor account execution by direct reports using CURO and other business tools to insure accomplishment of execution expectations.
Engage prioritized accounts directly to establish relationships with key customers, in support of advancing organizational objectives.
Bachelor’s degree required.
Advanced analytical, coaching, direct people leadership, communication and presentation skills.
Knowledge of applicable regulations and standards affecting business.
Ability to examine complex business environment and develop/execute plans in response to market and account opportunities.
In-depth experience working within large accounts and across KAM/Matrix teams strongly preferred but not required.
Immunology sales/sales leadership preferred but not required.
Driving a personal auto or company car or truck, or a powered piece of material handling equipment
Valid driver’s license: Ability to pass a pre-employment drug screening test and meet safe driving requirements

title: Senior Scientist I
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
We are searching for a highly motivated Senior Scientist I to join our Analytical Development team at Waltham, MA. Our team is responsible for the development, qualification, and execution of analytical methods to provide product and process understanding for biological entities from discovery through commercial stages. As a Senior Scientist I, you will be a part of the Analytical Characterization Group (ACG) within the Analytical Development department. ACG focuses on providing routine, investigative, and in-depth characterization as well as proteomics analyses of AbbVie's biologics to support product and process development for early-phase, late-phase, and commercial programs using liquid chromatography mass spectrometry (LC-MS), spectroscopy, and various other biophysical characterization assays. The successful candidate will contribute to the development and performance of analytical assays and will contribute to the continuous improvement and innovation within ACG and the Analytical Development department. The incumbent operates with a high degree of independence, contributes project science in their area of expertise, and develops productive collaborations across disciplines.
Responsibilities:
Independently perform LC-MS analyses (e.g., intact, reduced, sub-unit, peptide mapping, and disulfide bond mapping) of AbbVie's biologics to provide sequence verification, post-translational modification profiles, sequence variant levels, and disulfide bond profiles.
Independently perform separation methods (e.g., fractionation of variants) and biophysical methods of AbbVie's biologics to support characterization studies.
Design and execute experiments for method development and/or investigations.
Generate and communicate precise, reliable, and reproducible data in a timely manner.
Organize and document experiments and results in an electronic laboratory notebook; author and review protocols, method development reports, and technical characterization reports.
Represent the Analytical Development department in cross-functional program teams as characterization lead for AbbVie's biologics in development pipeline.
Maintain laboratory equipment, provide troubleshooting, and coordinate services/PMs.
Routinely demonstrate scientific initiative and creativity in research or development activities.
Highly autonomous and productive in performing laboratory research or method development, requiring only minimal direction from or interaction with supervisor.
Direct mentorship of junior scientists and others in the lab.
PhD or Masters in chemistry, biology, biochemistry or related technical discipline with typically 0–3 (PhD) or 8+ (MS) years of relevant experience in a biotech/pharmaceutical industry setting.

The Technical Delivery Lead for Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) leads a small, high-velocity engineering team that embeds directly with frontline business partners across product development, manufacturing, Quality and Finance. Working side by side with scientists, operators, quality professionals and finance teams at our sites, this leader identifies critical business problems, then uses data science, AI and modern software engineering to design and ship working prototypes in weeks, not quarters.
This is more than an individual contributor engineering role. The successful candidate is accountable for the technical direction, quality and delivery pace of FDE engagements, leads and develops the engineers on each engagement, and is a hands-on builder who sets the technical bar for the team.
Responsibilities:
Technical delivery leadership
Serve as technical delivery lead for a portfolio of fast-paced FDE engagements, owning scope, architecture, technical risk, timelines, and outcomes from problem framing through prototype and handoff.
Lead, coach, and assign work to a team of forward deployed engineers, data scientists, and partner resources; set engineering standards, review designs and code, and build team capability.
Run short, iterative delivery cycles (e.g., discovery sprints, weekly demos) that move rapidly from hypothesis to a working solution in users’ hands.
Make clear build/buy/scale decisions and define the path from prototype to production with BTS platform, product, and support teams.
Frontline partnership
Travel to AbbVie sites to work directly with frontline employees—on the manufacturing floor, in labs, in Quality and in Finance—to observe workflows, understand pain points and co-design solutions.
Translate ambiguous operational and financial problems into well-defined technical problems with measurable success criteria (e.g., cycle time, yield, right-first-time, deviation reduction, close timeliness).
Build trusted relationships with site leaders and business stakeholders; communicate progress, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Hands-on solution development
Rapidly develop prototypes using data science, machine learning, generative AI / LLM and agentic tools, analytics, and application development frameworks.
Integrate with enterprise and operational data sources such as MES, LIMS, QMS, ERP (e.g., SAP), historians, and data lake / cloud platforms.
Apply AI-assisted development practices to accelerate delivery while maintaining code quality, security, and maintainability.
Ensure solutions are designed with appropriate data integrity, privacy, cybersecurity, and responsible AI considerations, and engage Quality/CSV partners early where GxP impact exists.
Scale and impact
Capture reusable patterns, components and playbooks so successful solutions can be replicated across sites and functions.
Quantify and report business value delivered by FDE engagements; help shape the FDE engagement model and pipeline with BTS Operations & Finance leadership.
Required:
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, a physical/life science, or related field with 7 years of relevant experience; Master’s Degree with 6 years of experience; or PhD with 2 years of experience.
Demonstrated experience delivering data, analytics, AI, or software solutions in the life sciences industry (pharmaceutical, biotech or medical device) across one or more of: product development, manufacturing, Quality or Finance.
Proven track record leading technical teams—setting direction, mentoring engineers and accountable for delivery of multiple concurrent projects.
Strong hands-on engineering skills in Python and SQL, with experience building and deploying ML/AI solutions, including generative AI / LLM applications.
Experience with cloud data and compute platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Databricks, Snowflake) and modern software practices (Git, CI/CD, APIs, containerization).
Experience working in rapid, iterative delivery environments—taking ambiguous problems to working prototypes on short timelines.
Working knowledge of regulated environments (GxP, data integrity, computerized system validation) and how they shape solution design.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable working directly with frontline staff and presenting to senior leaders.
Willingness and ability to travel to sites up to 20% of the time.
Preferred:
Prior forward deployed, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or internal innovation “skunkworks” team experience.
Familiarity with manufacturing and quality systems and data (MES, LIMS, QMS, historians such as OSIsoft PI) and/or finance systems (SAP, planning and close tools).
Experience with agentic AI frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, computer vision, or optimization/simulation methods.
Experience with full-stack or low-code application development for rapid user-facing tools (e.g., React, Streamlit, Power Apps).
Experience moving prototypes to scaled, supported production solutions in partnership with platform and product teams.

location: San Jose; San Francisco; Seattle; New York
description:
The Opportunity
Adobe’s Business Ethics & Integrity organization is continuing to evolve our data-driven, risk-based approach to compliance - one that proactively identifies emerging risks, continuously evaluates the effectiveness of our controls, and uses data and technology to generate meaningful insights and drive continuous improvement.
We’re looking for a Compliance Risk & Assurance professional to help continue maturing these capabilities across Adobe’s global Business Ethics & Integrity program. This role will connect compliance risk assessments, monitoring, targeted compliance reviews, and analytics to help us understand where our most significant risks are, whether our compliance processes and controls are effectively mitigating those risks, and where we should focus our efforts and resources.
You’ll work across Business Ethics & Integrity and partner closely with Legal, Internal Audit, and other teams to develop scalable, risk-based assurance and monitoring capabilities. You’ll also support compliance due diligence in M&A and explore opportunities to leverage data, analytics, automation, and emerging technologies - including AI - to strengthen risk identification, improve efficiency, and generate actionable insights.
This is an opportunity to help shape how a global technology company identifies and manages compliance risks, evaluates program effectiveness, and drives continuous improvement.
What You'll Do
Develop and execute compliance risk assessments to identify, evaluate, and prioritize ethics and compliance risks across Adobe’s businesses, geographies, and operations.
Design and implement risk-based compliance monitoring and assurance activities to evaluate the effectiveness of compliance processes and controls, identify gaps, and drive remediation and continuous improvement.
Build and enhance continuous monitoring capabilities, leveraging compliance and business data to identify emerging risks, trends, anomalies, and potential control weaknesses across key compliance risk areas.
Develop meaningful risk indicators, dashboards, metrics, and reporting to provide leadership with actionable insights into compliance risks, program effectiveness, and opportunities for improvement.
Partner with Legal, Internal Audit, and business stakeholders to evaluate findings, identify root causes, develop practical remediation plans, and strengthen compliance processes and controls.
Support M&A compliance risk assessments and due diligence, including identifying potential ethics and compliance risks and supporting post-close integration and remediation.
Leverage analytics, automation, AI, and emerging technologies to improve the efficiency, scalability, and effectiveness of compliance risk assessment, monitoring, and assurance activities.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
8+ years of relevant experience in corporate ethics and compliance, compliance risk management, or compliance monitoring and assurance, ideally within a global company or similarly complex environment. Experience in internal audit or risk advisory may be relevant when accompanied by substantive corporate ethics and compliance experience.
Strong understanding of corporate ethics and compliance programs, including key compliance risk areas, regulatory expectations, risk assessment methodologies, compliance monitoring, and approaches to evaluating program effectiveness.
Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, or executing compliance risk assessments, risk-based compliance monitoring, targeted compliance reviews, or compliance assurance activities.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to use compliance and business data to identify emerging risks, evaluate trends and anomalies, assess program effectiveness, and inform risk-based decisions.
Experience developing or leveraging metrics, dashboards, key risk indicators, and management reporting to support risk-based decision-making.

Knowledge of core corporate compliance risk areas, including anti-corruption, conflicts of interest, gifts and hospitality, and third-party risk.
Experience with M&A compliance due diligence, integration, or risk assessment is preferred.
Strong critical thinking, professional skepticism, and sound judgment, with the ability to connect data, compliance observations, and business context to broader compliance risks.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex findings into clear, practical recommendations for senior leaders.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
The Opportunity
Adobe Workfront is the work management platform that enterprises rely on to plan, run, and measure work across thousands of people, projects, and approvals. Behind it are engineering teams who understand both the platform and the complex, often regulated environments where customers use it.
The Forward Deployed Engineer role sits at the intersection of software engineering, solution architecture, and technical consulting. You will be embedded with Workfront's most strategic customers, working directly with their teams to solve hard platform challenges, design scalable integrations, and build what is needed to unblock adoption and expansion.
You will work in a cross-functional Customer Pod: a small, autonomous team with end-to-end ownership. As a senior engineer, you set technical direction for your accounts, mentor other builders, and close the gap between what customers need and what the platform delivers.
What You'll Do
Partner with strategic customers to understand their workflows, systems, security requirements, and business goals.
Turn complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes.
Build and ship custom integrations and extensions across Workfront Workflow, Workfront Planning, Workfront Fusion, APIs, and adjacent Adobe and third-party systems.
Investigate and resolve production issues, from data and permissions models to automation, reporting, and performance.
Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep dives that earn customer trust.
Prototype and iterate quickly, using AI-assisted tools as a standard part of how you work.
Feed field patterns back to product and engineering to shape the Workfront roadmap.
Mentor engineers in the pod and set practices for how the team documents decisions and learnings.
Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts from discovery through go-live and expansion.
What Success Looks Like
We hire for demonstrated impact, not credential accumulation. Strong candidates show:
Customer empathy. You meet customers on their terms and understand their constraints and definition of success.
Ownership at senior level. You find problems before they are assigned and drive them to resolution without waiting for permission.
Clear communication. You explain complex ideas to technical and executive audiences in workshops, architecture reviews, and briefings.
Business acumen. You understand the use case before choosing the technology.
Software craft. You write code, build prototypes, and ship working software. Your designs reflect implementation reality.
Data and integration judgment. You weigh trade-offs in data models, API design, and system integration.
Growth mindset and AI fluency. You use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) to design, prototype, and deliver, and you build toward agentic capabilities.
Typical background: 8 to 12 years in software engineering, solution architecture, technical consulting, or customer-facing engineering. What matters is what that experience produced, not the title or the number of years.
Your Domain
Work management platforms: Workfront or comparable tools (project, portfolio, resource, planning, proofing, and approval workflows).
Integration and automation: REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven patterns, and low-code or workflow orchestration tools such as Workfront Fusion.
Enterprise architecture: Multi-system integration, SSO and identity, data flows, and API design across complex landscapes.
Application development: Strong skills in a modern language such as Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python.
Cloud and data: AWS or Azure, plus reporting and analytics pipelines.
Security and compliance: Enterprise permissions, data privacy, and regulated-industry constraints.
Nice to Have
Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud or Creative Cloud products, including Adobe Experience Manager Assets, Workfront Planning, or Adobe GenStudio.
Background in SaaS work management, PPM, or marketing operations platforms.
Experience building agentic or LLM-powered workflows in enterprise settings.
Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or government.
Track record of driving architecture decisions at team or organization level.
How You'll Work: Pod-Based Execution
You operate within a small, cross-functional Customer Pod embedded with specific strategic accounts. Each pod has a customer representative for feedback and validation, a product manager for prioritization, engineers and builders for implementation and experimentation, and an account team with enterprise architects for alignment and strategy.
The Forward Deployed Engineer is the technical execution backbone of the pod: customer-facing, hands-on, and focused on rapid end-to-end delivery. We run small, time-boxed experiments, keep tight customer feedback loops, prototype before fully building, document decisions, and use staged rollouts to reduce risk.
Why This Team
Solve complex enterprise problems with direct customer impact. Your solutions go live in production, not in slide decks.
Work in autonomous pods embedded with Adobe's most strategic accounts.
Combine architecture, engineering, and customer engagement in one role, so no two weeks look the same.
Help shape a new engineering engagement model built on rapid experimentation and AI-assisted execution.
Join the Lehi engineering community alongside experienced Workfront platform engineers.

Work with Treasury on cash pool and intercompany funding accounting, including settlements with FX, accrued and capitalized interest, and reconciliations.

title: Air Program Manager, AWS Environmental
description:
Join a diverse, dynamic, and enthusiastic team of environmental compliance professionals who play a leading role in air quality permitting and compliance at Amazon Web Services (AWS), where we have a history of leading the world in innovative technologies and services. As a member of the Environmental team, you will support environmental programs aimed at ensuring compliance with air quality regulations and standards in the Americas while also enabling AWS's growth around the world.
As an Air Program Manager, your primary focus will be serving as the air compliance subject matter expert (SME) across an Americas sub-region, providing programmatic oversight and ensuring alignment of compliance practices across all AWS data centers. You will build regional-level compliance infrastructure (frameworks, standards, tools, and visibility) and provide functional direction to the Regional Environmental Engineers (REEs) who execute compliance at their sites. You will work closely with the Environmental team, engineering, operations teams, vendors, and other partners to ensure consistent application of air quality compliance programs, particularly those related to Tier 4 compliant diesel generators. Your role will involve providing technical expertise on local, state, and federal air regulations and creating strategies for continuous improvement in air compliance management. As the team's air compliance SME, you will support REEs across the region to resolve complex air compliance challenges and drive environmental performance. You will also play a key role in standardizing incident response and reporting protocols related to air compliance events.
The successful candidate will have extensive knowledge of air compliance and regulatory requirements in North America, demonstrated ability to develop and standardize complex compliance systems across multiple jurisdictions, and proven experience leading air quality initiatives that drive environmental performance and sustainability. The ideal candidate will excel at providing strategic guidance while maintaining strong attention to technical details and have a track record of successfully collaborating with diverse stakeholders to implement environmental compliance programs at scale.
Key job responsibilities
- Build and lead regional air quality compliance programs, providing standards and functional direction to in-region engineers across North and South America
- Set and maintain the regional framework for compliance with federal, state, and local air quality regulations related to emergency backup power systems
- Ensure compliance with EPA regulations including 40 CFR 60 Subpart IIII (Standards of Performance for Stationary Compression Ignition Internal Combustion Engines)
- Develop and implement air quality monitoring programs and compliance tracking systems for permitted backup power generation (Tier 2/Tier 4 diesel generators, natural gas, etc)
- Establish standardized emissions testing programs and protocols that engineers and testing firms execute at their sites
- Provide technical guidance on air quality compliance requirements
- Support emergency response planning related to air quality incidents
- Collaborate with the air permitting team and in-region engineers to ensure operational compliance with existing permit conditions
- Stay current with evolving air quality regulations and industry best practices for diesel generator management
- Develop and deliver air quality compliance training for relevant staff
- Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for air quality compliance
About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
Basic qualifications: - 5+ years of increasing responsibilities in EHS or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations experience, or Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years with air permitting and/or compliance experience at local, state, federal levels
Preferred qualifications: - Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Experience developing and implementing environmental compliance programs including regulated waste, water, and air regulations in accordance with applicable laws
- 3+ years with engine specific regulations including 40 CFR 63 Subpart ZZZZ and 40 CFR 60 Subpart IIII

title: New Product Lead , Robotics Supply Chain
description:
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Amazon Robotics. We are a smart team of doers that work passionately to apply advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even imagine yet.
Amazon Robotics has locations in the greater Boston and Seattle area, the epicenter of robotics innovation. Our diverse teams come from all over the world to design, test and build our dynamic fleet of robots, mechatronic systems and pack automation solutions. Having our offices, labs, test floors and factories all co-located means that we can design the hardware, write the code, test, build and watch it all come to life. This allows us to innovate quickly and on limitless ideas. Current advancements are underway in autonomous movement and mobility, artificial intelligence and machine learning, manipulation, simulation, robotic management software, predictive analytics, and much more.
The Amazon Robotics Supply Chain provides strategic sourcing for a portfolio of robotic technologies and is responsible for delivering new products by enabling the right suppliers and technologies, and getting the right materials at the right cost to the right place at the right time to support our network of global fulfillment and transportation solutions. It is a fast-paced operation that works cross-functionally with teams across Amazon and is driven by data and metrics.
We are seeking Robotics Supply Chain New Product Lead - Tech tackle to most critical, technologically advanced products at Amazon. The Lead will be responsible for a small portfolio of robotic products and accountable for supplier and supply chain strategies, product cost roadmaps, enabling rapid NPI builds, and ensuring a successful ramp to mass production. They manage their products from concept, through development, to scaled deployment. They work with senior product and engineering leaders to drive appropriate trade-offs between commercial vs. technical constraints, risks and goals. Within the robotic product they lead, they must be able to drive the multiple advanced technologies and commodities, driving a clear path to production.
Essential to the role is a level of technical subject matter expertise to work effectively with the technical teams developing these robotic products. While it varies by group, this expertise includes an understanding of the technologies and architectures of the robotic products and key commodities that make up the robotic products, including the technology’s development and integration strategy and trajectory, both within Amazon and its wider position in the business and industry. This role will contribute to technical strategies and decisions, with contributions that balance technical and business requirements, to help drive engineering teams toward scalable products that achieve Amazon’s cost targets.
The RSC New Product Lead - Tech is a trusted subject matter expert, consulted by teams above and below. They clearly communicate with direct and indirect stakeholders, advocating for commercial opportunities at the Director level and above. They contribute to strategic documents for aligning goals with cross-functional teams, own reporting on forecasting and planning the business impact of each opportunity, and regularly report on the status and impact of their contributions. Their impact is measurable via quantifiable metrics, and they have the ability to deeply influence measurable business outcomes.
We are looking for strong business owners who can Think Big, Deliver Results, and leaders who are ready to make long lasting impact to Amazon Robotics technologies. They should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where delivery time for new products and features is typically measured in months. The leader will have a proven background in Robotics automation, global supplier management and new product introduction on the development and scaled production of advanced technology. The successful candidate for this position will be experienced working with cross-functional leaders from product, engineering, manufacturing, and field operations. They are self-managing, have a high sense of urgency and driven to achieve product development and deployment. They will be a highly visible leader that will own the communication, coordination execution, and delivery of a multi-year program vision.
Key job responsibilities
- Support the product development process by working across cross-functional supply chain teams focused on supplier management, supply chain design, sourcing, logistics, and supply chain execution for robotics products from concept through scaled deployment.
- Serve as a key point of contact for program teams to communicate supply chain decisions and progress, share feedback on supply chain implications of program changes, and support financial planning and capital approval processes.
- Partner with Robotics leadership and cross-functional teams — including hardware engineering, operations, and program management — on commodity and supplier selection, cost-performance tradeoff analysis, cost roadmap development, and supporting rapid product development and scaled deployment.
- Support the development of Product-level Supply Chain Strategy documents, including identification of critical components and suppliers, product cost roadmaps, capacity planning, sourcing and tooling requirements, and supply chain risk assessment and mitigation plans.
- Collaborate with sourcing teams to develop negotiation strategies for categories impacting the product, working toward business objectives and building sustainable supplier relationships for Amazon Robotics priority programs aligned to the Operating Plan (OP).
- Work with Global Commodity Managers (GCMs) to support supplier relationship management, including supplier performance, capability development, capacity planning, contracting, risk mitigation, and cost and quality improvements.
- Contribute to roadmap development for achieving NPI and GA total cost targets (TCO), including make vs. buy analysis and value engineering opportunities.
- Support non-cost goals including Sustainability, Supplier Development, and Cost Savings as part of the product-specific supply chain strategy.
- 20–25% travel required.
